en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with a central statue of a man on a pedestal surrounded by a cast‑iron fence, a fountain to the left, and rows of multi‑story gabled buildings with shops at street level. In the background stands a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped spire and clock. Shop signs on the facades are in German, indicating various businesses around the square.
